headlines.title: Memory Trade Warnings Pile Up: Dell’s Tripled Inventory Says Chip Supply Is “a Lot Closer” to Demand
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysDell shares fell nearly 11% on Friday, October 30, after Intel warned that memory prices and tight supply are slowing PC demand. Satori Fund founder Dan Niles says Dell’s inventory, nearly tripled from a year ago, shows chip supply is much closer to demand than chipmakers think, and Dell’s balance sheet backs him up.

headlines.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Unveiled New Cybersecurity Tools For AI Environments
headlines.summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL) unveiled new cybersecurity and resilience features for AI environments, alongside refreshed integrated AI infrastructure solutions. The update introduces quantum safe encryption, identity resilience tools, and tighter security integration across Dell's storage platforms for AI workloads. The company positioned the expanded portfolio as targeting customer concerns around protection and recovery for mission critical AI systems.

headlines.title: Dell Technologies vs. Intel: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Dell's free cash flow engine contrasts sharply with Intel's negative cash burn, reshaping how investors should weigh growth against restructuring risk.

headlines.title: Super Micro Drops 5% Ahead of Earnings as AI Server Selloff Extends; Dell Falls 4%, HPE Slides 3%
headlines.summary: AI server stocks are sliding hard ahead of a critical earnings report, and the question hanging over the sector is whether surging revenue can survive a brutal squeeze on margins and cash flow.

headlines.title: CrowdStrike and Dell Technologies Announce Integrated AI Security for the Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA
headlines.summary: AUSTIN, Texas & ROUND ROCK, Texas & BARCELONA, Spain, November 02, 2026--Fal.Con Europe 2026--CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) and Dell Technologies (NYSE: DELL) today announced an integrated security solution for the Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA. Customers can use the CrowdStrike Falcon® platform to secure enterprise AI infrastructure, workloads, agents and applications, alongside Dell AI infrastructure and services and NVIDIA accelerated computing.

description: Dell Technologies Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, markets, sells, and supports various comprehensive and integrated solutions, products, and services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) and Client Solutions Group (CSG) segments. The ISG segment provides modern and traditional storage solutions, including all-flash, purpose-built, hyper-converged infrastructure, software-defined storage, and general-purpose and AI-optimized servers. This segment also offers networking products and services comprising wide area network infrastructure, data center and edge networking switches, and cables and optics that help its business customers to transform and modernize their infrastructure and complementing its server and storage solutions; and software, peripherals, and services, including consulting and support, and deployment. The CSG segment provides notebooks, desktops, and workstations and branded peripherals that include displays, docking stations, keyboards, mice, webcam and audio devices, and third-party software and peripherals; and configuration, and extended warranties services. The company is involved in originating, collecting, and servicing customer financing arrangements and offers payment and consumption solutions and services, such utility, subscription, as-a-service, leases, and loans, as well as fixed-term leases and loans. It serves enterprises, governmental agencies and other public institutions, educational institutions, healthcare organizations, small and medium-sized businesses, and consumers. The company has a strategic alliance with Rafay Systems for the development of AI infrastructure solutions. The company was formerly known as Denali Holding Inc. and changed its name to Dell Technologies Inc. in March 2013. Dell Technologies Inc. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Round Rock, Texas.
